name: aivv
description: General advisory review of session work, documents, plans, decisions, and code, with finding investigation and gated remediation.

interface.longDescription: Review session work, documents, plans, decisions, and code. AIVV clarifies material scope or method ambiguity, investigates selected findings, and applies fixes through explicit safety gates. It records review state outside the project checkout and reports when reviewer isolation or other capabilities are unavailable. It does not replace tests, security testing, or organizational review.
defaultPrompt: Review this session's work with AIVV.
